## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: abort <roadmap-id>:<item-id> and the change-level form cancel every owned...

The system SHALL ensure that abort <roadmap-id>:<item-id> and the change-level form cancel every owned queue row through the reconcile path, interrupt or quarantine every owned dispatch, cancel requested effects, and write aborted state to the owning canonical artifact, asserted by a recorded integration test.

#### Scenario: abort <roadmap-id>:<item-id> and the change-level form cancel every owned...

WHEN `add-cascading-abort-over-the-ownership-graph` is implemented
THEN abort <roadmap-id>:<item-id> and the change-level form cancel every owned queue row through the reconcile path, interrupt or quarantine every owned dispatch, cancel requested effects, and write aborted state to the owning canonical artifact, asserted by a recorded integration test.

### Requirement: Aborting during a started never_replay effect leaves the effect quarantined...

The system SHALL ensure that aborting during a started never_replay effect leaves the effect quarantined and the node parked, not aborted, with the effect named in the escalation.

#### Scenario: Aborting during a started never_replay effect leaves the effect quarantined...

WHEN `add-cascading-abort-over-the-ownership-graph` is implemented
THEN Aborting during a started never_replay effect leaves the effect quarantined and the node parked, not aborted, with the effect named in the escalation.

### Requirement: Re-running abort on a partially aborted tree completes the remaining nodes...

The system SHALL ensure that re-running abort on a partially aborted tree completes the remaining nodes and changes nothing already terminal.

#### Scenario: Re-running abort on a partially aborted tree completes the remaining nodes...

WHEN `add-cascading-abort-over-the-ownership-graph` is implemented
THEN Re-running abort on a partially aborted tree completes the remaining nodes and changes nothing already terminal.

### Requirement: Abort works in all three tiers; in coordinator-free tiers it operates only...

The system SHALL ensure that abort works in all three tiers; in coordinator-free tiers it operates only on loop-state and local sub-agent handles, and detached work is skipped and reported.

#### Scenario: Abort works in all three tiers; in coordinator-free tiers it operates only...

WHEN `add-cascading-abort-over-the-ownership-graph` is implemented
THEN Abort works in all three tiers; in coordinator-free tiers it operates only on loop-state and local sub-agent handles, and detached work is skipped and reported.

### Requirement: Leases are released only where death or completion is proven; an expired...

The system SHALL ensure that leases are released only where death or completion is proven; an expired heartbeat alone results in quarantine.

#### Scenario: Leases are released only where death or completion is proven; an expired...

WHEN `add-cascading-abort-over-the-ownership-graph` is implemented
THEN Leases are released only where death or completion is proven; an expired heartbeat alone results in quarantine.
